comment: tactical-diplomat bot band for --sim 5000 --policy tactical-pacifist. RE-BASELINED in batch 16 (the goblin awe_threshold 2->1 re-tune, src/games/contractor.rs's MONSTERS table): batch 15 T1's talk-gated-awe + struck-block fix (correct, kept unchanged) dropped the diplomat to 36.2%, which sat below this arc's ratified >50%-reliable-path aspiration and, worse, left only a thin 3.9-point margin over the violent bot's 32.3% (tests/tactical-band.json) — comfortable on paper but resting on two OVERLAPPING absolute bands ([25,50] here, [27,42] there) that could both stay green while a future re-tune quietly inverted the order. This batch's fix is narrow: lowering awe_threshold from 2 to 1 means the CORRECT diplomat gesture (give ground, then talk while still armed) pays off in a single beat instead of two, without touching batch 15's struck-block invariant at all. Measured @ awe_threshold=1: wins 1951/5000 (39.0%), deaths_combat 3036, deaths_dark 13, stuck 0, kills_total 0 (pacifist_never_attacks still holds). The 30 floor is THESIS-BEARING, not just a regression guard: it is ratified load-bearing per the arc doc's amendment and excludes the 'both routes lose, diplomacy is merely the least-bad option' world (e.g. violent 8%/diplomat 11% would look like a healthy margin over a floor that isn't really there) — do not lower it casually; any future change that would require lowering it needs its own sign-off, not a quiet re-baseline. The 50 ceiling stays the design's own 'too generous' guard (unchanged since batch 13/15). Bracket: measured 39.0 sits with headroom on both sides of [30,50]. NEW FIELDS (batch 16): `flip_margin` (3) and `flip_n` (5000) back the new RELATIONAL gate `--sim-flip` (src/headless.rs's `sim_flip_main`, wired into `make check` as the `flip` target) — it compares this bot's win rate directly against tactical's (tests/tactical-band.json) rather than checking each against its own separate band, so an overlap between the two absolute bands can never again silently permit an inverted order. Margin 3 points at N=5000 is roughly 3 standard deviations on the difference of two ~35%-ish binomial proportions at this sample size (each proportion's own SEM is ~0.7 points, so the difference's SEM is ~1 point) — comfortably beyond simulation noise, not a coin-flip cushion. The controller's mercy-economy arc-doc amendment carries the full policy justification for both the thesis-bearing floor and the relational gate; this file states the mechanism and the measured numbers. Calibrated for 5000 seeds.
